body:
## Goal

Step 1, PR P of the UI plan #4245. The docked side panes (Browser, Properties and the other side panes) fold to a title chip, so that the viewport gets the space. A click on the chip unfolds the pane. The fold state is part of the saved panel setups (#2339). View ▸ Reset layout puts the default layout back.

## What is decided (#4245, maintainer answers and the review of 2026-11-28)

- Docked panes that fold to chips. The word in the UI is "fold" (not "collapse").
- The target screen size is 1366×768.
- The fold and chip components live in the kit crate (`crates/ui-kit`, PR K #4397).
- The status bar keeps the last command and drops the counts. The folded issues line keeps the counts (this PR only prepares the fold; PR I fills the issues pane).

## egui_dock facts (checked against egui_dock 0.21.1, the version in `Cargo.lock`)

- Panes stacked top over bottom (`Node::Vertical`): native. `LeafNode::collapsed` is a public, serde-persisted flag. A collapsed leaf gets the tab-bar height. When code sets the flag, it must also correct the parents' collapsed counts: the fix-up function of egui_dock is `pub(crate)`, so this PR needs a small helper.
- Panes side by side (`Node::Horizontal`, the left Browser and the right Properties): `collapsed` changes only the arrow, not the width. Drive `SplitNode::fraction`: save the old fraction on fold, set the chip width, apply it again after a window resize, and restore it on unfold. Tab headers are horizontal only, so draw a chip in the shell for a folded side pane. The tab stays in the tree, so it stays docked and persisted.
- `DockArea` shows the built-in collapse button on every leaf today (`shell.rs`). On side panes it does nothing to the layout: replace or hide it.

## Done means

- Each side pane folds to a chip and unfolds again, with one click. A drag on the separator does not unfold a folded pane by accident.
- The fold state of each pane is saved in the panel setups and restored on load. A project file or setup file from before this change loads with all panes unfolded.
- View ▸ Reset layout restores the default layout with no pane folded.
- Tests: fold and unfold of a vertical and a horizontal pane, persistence through a saved setup, the reset, and a window resize while folded. The layout tests (`layout_page_*` / `layout_window_*`) and the structural tests are updated. The `crates/ui` test count does not go down (#1953). No snapshot PNG changes.
- Before and after screenshots at 1366×768.
- No change to toolpaths, posts or the project file format.

Part of #4245.
